description: From the first words of a subject (a prefix is enough), the pages of the network that answer it: pages being looked up right now first, then the site whose subject it is. Returns up to 8 { title, url, site, line }. With no words it returns what is being looked up right now.

q.description: The subject, or the first words of it. Empty = what the World is looking up right now.

name: suggest
title: Suggest pages from the first words
